definitions.explanation: A formal proposal or item submitted for discussion and decision in a legislative body, committee meeting, or assembly.

examples.japanese: {議案|ぎあん}が{可決|かけつ}された。
{新|あたら}しい{議案|ぎあん}が{提出|ていしゅつ}された。
{本日|ほんじつ}の{会議|かいぎ}では{三|みっ}つの{議案|ぎあん}について{審議|しんぎ}が{行|おこな}われる{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: Three agenda items are scheduled for deliberation at today's meeting.

notes:
A formal term used in parliamentary, legislative, and corporate meeting contexts. Composed of {議|ぎ} (deliberation) and {案|あん} (plan/proposal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議案|ぎあん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a bill/proposal
- {議案|ぎあん}が{可決|かけつ}される: a bill is passed
- {議案|ぎあん}が{否決|ひけつ}される: a bill is rejected
- {議案|ぎあん}を{審議|しんぎ}する: to deliberate on a bill
- {議案|ぎあん}{書|しょ}: written proposal document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {法案|ほうあん}: legislative bill — specifically a proposed law
- {提案|ていあん}: suggestion/proposal — more general, used in everyday contexts
- {動議|どうぎ}: motion — a procedural proposal during a meeting
